finding: The dominant cost is provider response time, not the cooldown, so shortening the cooldown cannot make this design feasible. Both models share one provider, so one lock serialises the entire campaign.
method: Serial wall time projected from the sealed full-trajectory gate, as the campaign SOP requires before launching a variance pilot. Cells execute one at a time and the completion-to-start cooldown holds the provider lock for the whole call, so no two calls to one provider overlap and throughput is independent of cell count.
